facts.fact: The ITU Cyberwellness Profile, last updated 12 March 2015, states Eritrea has no officially recognized national cybersecurity strategy, no officially recognized national CIRT and no agency responsible for cybersecurity.
facts.system: National cybersecurity strategy and national CIRT

note: States only that Eritrea has no public national cybersecurity strategy and that the government announced a repelled cyberattack in May 2024; it does not state that no national body exists, and no national cyber body handled or alerted.
Government statement of a foiled attack names no national body, strategy or alert.
